name: X-Man Tornado V3 3x3 Premium (Flagship UV)
description: X-Man Tornado V3 3x3 Premium (Flagship UV) is the highly anticipated evolution of the legendary Tornado V3, crafted for dedicated speedcubers seeking the ultimate solving experience. This flagship model elevates the standard set by the original with several major innovations:
features: Reinforced Integrated Core: Designed for greater durability and stability, dramatically reducing core breakage and magnet loss.
Unified Magnet System: Magnets are securely embedded within a spherical core shell, delivering an exceptionally consistent turning feel on every face.
Enjoy smoother, softer turning and a precise, tactile feel, thanks to cutting-edge magnet architecture and premium engineering.
